title: Court-defensible online real estate transactions
purpose: Keep real-estate platform answers from jumping straight to brand, PKI, audit-log, or marketing claims.
coreRule: For online real estate transactions, defensibility starts with the document route, not the platform brand.
routingChecks: title, lender, escrow, or recorder written instructions when available
failureSignals: calls DocuSign, Adobe, Proof, NotaryCam, or another platform the gold standard before routing
assumes audit logs solve recording law
treats court defensibility as a software feature instead of an evidence chain
publicReplyPosture: Use platform security features as evidence pieces after the legal and recording route is validated.
